themes.description: The app is prone to crashing, freezing, and experiencing technical issues, resulting in frustrating experiences for users. This theme highlights several critical complaints regarding the stability and usability of the app.
themes.business_impact: High churn risk due to increased user frustration and abandonment of the app, potentially leading to revenue loss.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Insufficient testing, inadequate backend infrastructure, and poor optimization of resources may be contributing to the app's instability.
themes.action_plan:
• Thoroughly test and debug the app's codebase
• Implement proper error handling and crash reporting tools
• Invest in upgrading backend infrastructure and optimizing resource allocation.
